A.title: Stormglass Stair
A.text: The stair winds up through the spire. Lightning marks cut into each step still glow. They show which steps hold. The dark ones do not.

Y.title: The Gale Hall
Y.text: The wind inside turns on itself and never settles. The walls were built to bend with it. Lean the way the wall leans and you will not be pushed off.

R.title: Boulder Under the Roof
R.text: A boulder with a cut line across it. Strike on the line and it rings. Keepers say the swiftest blow is the one that is already done when you see it.

G.title: Vault Door, Left Open
G.text: The vault was emptied in a hurry. Hinges melted by lightning. Whatever lived here left it open on purpose, or never meant to come back.

M.title: Rumble Stone
M.text: The thunder here is not a storm. It is old, and it comes from under the floor. Elder Mo's grandmother called it the world breathing.

O.title: Sky Watchers' Log
O.text: Lightning struck the spire eleven times today. We counted. Nobody was hurt, but Pell lost his eyebrows and has not stopped laughing.

U.title: Thunder-Iron Notes
U.text: A smith's recipe, torn: heat until it rings, quench in rain, never in a river. Lightning rods made this way do not melt. They sing.

X.title: The Anvil Bench
X.text: The anvil is cold, which is odd for a place so full of lightning. A smith's apron hangs from it. No one has ever claimed it.
